svg.aria-label: Sketch: the vehicle gate of Riverbend Maximum Security Institution in Nashville at night. A tall chain-link gate topped with coils of razor wire stands at centre beside a dark gatehouse; the rear of a fire engine marked E23 with chevron striping fills the left, and the rear of an ambulance with chevron doors and a roof light bar fills the right. A small sign reading Authorized Vehicles Only stands in front of a parked white SUV. Three figures are drawn as outlines from behind with no faces, one walking toward the ambulance. A blurred car hood crosses the lower right corner.
